data.one_liner: Create, read, edit, and convert DOCX files to PDF, HTML, and Markdown in pure Dart.
data.what_it_does: The library provides a fluent builder API to generate DOCX documents, parse existing DOCX files, and export them to PDF, HTML, or Markdown. It also includes readers for DOCX and PDF and supports embedding images, tables, shapes, and custom fonts.
use_when: You need to generate or modify Word documents on any platform without native code
You want to export documents to PDF, HTML, or Markdown directly from Dart
avoid_when: Exact Word feature parity is required, especially for PDF export gaps
You need real‑time collaborative editing of documents
strengths: Pure‑Dart implementation works on all Flutter platforms
Comprehensive DOCX features and PDF export with fallback fonts
Fluent builder API makes document creation concise
weaknesses: PDF export has some feature gaps compared to DOCX
Package size may be large due to font and image handling
